payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the baselines used in the experiments, including their types and methods.

claims.text: The baselines include Logistic Regression (LR), Gradient Boosting Decision Trees (GBDT), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN).
LR is a simple logistic regression using all meta and context information from the datasets.
GBDT is the best method among tree ensemble methods, using an ensemble of GBDTs with existing and manually constructed features.
RNN is the best method among sequence modeling methods according to the evidence provided.
